description: Registry of all AI knowledge artifacts for PSL Backend. Used by the harness to discover and load rules, skills, agents, protocols, and engine scenarios. Facade router: .claude/FACADE.md.

rules.summary: router → service → repository → SQLAlchemy; no SQL in routers/services; thin 1-line routers; DomainError subclasses over raw HTTPException.
ruff lint+format; snake_case; all IO async (async with); spell out locals; NO code comments unless asked.
no cross-layer imports (repos don't import services/routers); ruff-ordered absolute imports from app.*.
mypy on app/; type hints on all defs; SQLAlchemy 2.0 Mapped[] style; avoid Any.
files snake_case; routes kebab-case; classes PascalCase; UUID PKs + created/updated_at; schemas *Create/*Update/*Out.
pydantic v2 separate *Create/*Update/*Out; never reuse ORM models for API IO; validation/bounds in schemas.
alembic autogenerate → 0006_<slug>.py → set revision/down_revision → import model in __init__; op.bulk_insert seeds; never edit merged; Postgres-only.
pytest + httpx.AsyncClient; client/auth_client/admin_client fixtures; per-test TRUNCATE + Redis FLUSHDB; usernames ≥3; tests in app/tests/.
Stat XP ≥ 0, level ≥ 1, never decrease; BINARY forces quantity=1; delta = xp_change*quantity floored at 0; level formula floor(100*(L-1)**1.5).
argon2; JWT HS256 access 15m + opaque refresh 7d (sha256 in DB); CSRF double-submit; SameSite lax local/none+Secure prod; refresh rotation; protected files.
activities:templates 5-min TTL owned by ActivityService.list_templates; ORM event hooks invalidate on template/effect writes; mutate via ORM only.
fastapi-limiter==0.1.6 pinned; auth 10 req/60s; POST /activities/log 60 req/60s.
single responsibility; split oversized services/repositories; one aggregate per model file.
record architecture-shaping, hard-to-reverse decisions as ADRs (/adr, docs/adrs/); skip reversible detail; adr_reminder hook nudges.
one logical change per commit; Conventional Commits with scope; each commit builds independently; no Claude/Anthropic trailers.
changed-file-only lint (ruff_fix hook); never run repo-wide lint inside a task phase; CI owns hard enforcement.
OpenSpec requirement grammar FR/NFR/TC/BC-<AREA>-<n>; Verification vocab local-verifiable|migration|manual; tests # @trace <req-id>.

skills.summary: Thin routers behind /api/v1; one-line delegation to a service; DI via app/core/dependencies.py; DomainError → HTTP global handler.
Repo classes __init__(self, session: AsyncSession); async select()/scalars(); with_for_update locking; SQL lives only here.
autogenerate → 0006_<slug>.py → set revision/down_revision → import model in __init__; op.bulk_insert seeds; never edit merged; Postgres-only.
pydantic v2 *Create/*Update/*Out; never reuse ORM models; field validation + bounds; from_attributes for Out.
client/auth_client/admin_client fixtures; httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport; per-test TRUNCATE + FLUSHDB; TEST_DATABASE_URL override; tests in app/tests/.
LevelingService formulas; XP≥0, level≥1, never drop; delta = xp_change*quantity floored; single transaction per log; BINARY → quantity=1.
argon2; JWT HS256 access 15m + opaque refresh 7d; CSRF double-submit; cookie helpers; SameSite lax/none; refresh rotation; protected files.

Strict maintainability review of a branch/PR diff. Two parallel read-only agents per target — code-reviewer (changed files vs rules) + architecture-auditor (integration + boundaries) — merged into one ranked list (never a table). Hunts code-judo simplifications; refuses to redesign §4a. Current branch by default; multiple PR numbers fan out per PR. The strict sibling of /code-review.

Close the loop on the Claude PR review: read the bot's findings, auto-fix blockers + majors only, commit granularly, push (fires the deduping re-review), loop until 0 blockers + 0 majors or a 3-round cap. Leaves nits; pauses on spec conflict or §4a protected file. Final phase of /opsx:apply, or standalone.
